name: Arghadip Chakraborty
intro: I’m Arghadip. I make photographs, follow my curiosity, and collect stories along the way.
about: CuriousDip is my space for looking a little closer — through photo series, personal essays, and notes on the things that catch my eye. I’m interested in the connection between a place, a moment, and the feeling it leaves behind.

aboutSections.title: Hi, I’m Arghadip 👋
paragraphs: I’m currently based in Bengaluru, originally from West Bengal. I chase stories. I travel, make photographs, and write about the things that stay with me.

The camera is usually what gets me out there. Then curiosity takes over. A small detail catches my eye. I follow it. Sometimes it leads to a photograph. Sometimes to a story I hadn’t gone looking for. CuriousDip is where I’m bringing these pieces together.

aboutSections.title: Taking my time.
paragraphs: I like travelling slowly. Giving myself time to absorb a place. Its rhythm. Its everyday life. The things I would probably miss if I were already thinking about where to go next.

I’m drawn to the micro-stories. Small things unfolding within a much larger scene. They take time to notice, and I like spending that time. Walking around. Returning to the same spot. Waiting without knowing exactly what I’m waiting for. That’s often how my photographs begin.

aboutSections.title: A world within.
paragraphs: I feel privileged to have been born in a country like India. There’s so much here to experience. Colours, rituals, landscapes, languages. Stories overlapping, sometimes within the same street.

This is my canvas. The more I travel through it, the more I realise how little I’ve seen. Through my photographs and stories, I’m trying to explore this world within. Slowly. Following whatever makes me curious enough to stay a little longer.
